profile_text.body:
Discovery Education's DreamBox site describes online math and reading programs for students. The company says DreamBox Learning's solutions are now part of Discovery Education's family of products. DreamBox Math and Reading are described as personalized, adaptive instruction that lets educators scale differentiation, with DreamBox Math for grades K-8 and DreamBox Reading for grades K-5. The site says DreamBox Math combines curriculum with continuous formative assessment, and that DreamBox Reading is a data-driven program intended to improve silent reading fluency, comprehension and vocabulary through scaffolding. The company also describes an Intelligent Adaptive Learning feature across the programs.

The tracked product is DreamBox Math, listed under Education and Research AI with adaptive lessons for K-8 math, used by students and teachers through school accounts. Pricing is quote-based through Discovery Education, while third parties list $20 per student per year or $7,000 per school. The product note states DreamBox has been owned by Discovery Education since 2023, and that the entry was found in research for The AI Ready School and not independently verified. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for the company.
